budget.note: Planning rates are conservative assumptions, not verified Azure invoice rates. Persistent token ceilings are enforced; account charges require billing data.

config_per_worker.deployment_revision: deployment_alias:gpt-oss-120b; immutable provider snapshot not exposed

design.additional_cost_free: All R0/private/peer leaf substitution slates and six voter orders; source/readout sensitivity, not independent experiments.
design.cohort: All 130 previously reported extension questions, excluding original 20 pilot; exploratory cohort, new conditions frozen before new outputs.
design.failures: Malformed/refused completions count as abstentions with explicit counts. Unknown provider attempts halt all workers and block replay. No automatic retries, no outcome-based sample selection or stopping.
design.matching: Identical R0 states, local sources, system prompt, previous state, model alias, 4096-token output cap and 3 calls per arm; only peer_packets differ. Not input-token or realized-output-token matched.
design.primary: AA EM: all three peer revisions minus all three private revisions.
design.readout: Historical nonabstention plurality, ties earliest agent index 0,1,2. Sink index 1.
secondary: EM/F1 peer leaves versus private leaves with identical peer-updated sink
EM/F1 private leaves versus frozen initial leaves with identical peer-updated sink
design.statistics: Question paired bootstrap 10000 draws seed 20261016; primary exact McNemar EM. Secondary contrasts exploratory; never treat no significance as equivalence.

transport_amendment.classification: Recognize only HTTP429 plus code RateLimitReached and no choices; raw bodies remain unchanged. Other uncertain statuses remain blocked.
transport_amendment.invariants: Same frozen780 requests, same result selection, no efficacy checks, same2M input/2M output combined ceilings and original absolute6-hour deadline.
transport_amendment.pacing: Global4-second dispatch spacing; after explicit429 wait at least60seconds and double spacing up to32seconds. Up to2 known-rejection retries per key; max840 total attempts including imported attempts.
transport_amendment.physical_accounting: Continuation contains the complete original ledger. Do not add original ledgers again when calculating physical union.
transport_amendment.reason: HTTP429 raw body used top-level code RateLimitReached rather than nested error. It is a confirmed rejection, not an unknown timeout.
